maxbelasting.intro: Between 17:00 and 21:00 consumption peaks in hotels. Do you exceed your contracted capacity? Then sky-high penalties follow. Lemnion shaves peaks with battery storage and smart EMS.
maxbelasting.s1p: Between 17:00 and 21:00 all energy guzzlers come online at the same time: kitchens run at full power, guests shower, saunas and wellness facilities are used, lifts go up and down, air conditioners cool hundreds of rooms. The result: your consumption shoots far above your contracted capacity. Grid operators charge hefty penalties for exceeding it · sometimes thousands of euros per month. And requesting a higher contracted capacity? The grid operator has waiting times of months to years.
maxbelasting.c1p: The Lemnion battery charges during cheap off-peak hours (23:00-07:00, up to 60% lower rate) and discharges during expensive peak hours. This keeps you below your contracted capacity, without penalties and with lower grid fees.
maxbelasting.c2p: The Energy Management System learns your consumption pattern and adjusts automatically. The EMS knows exactly when the kitchens switch on and makes sure the battery delivers extra power at that moment.
maxbelasting.c3p: See live where every kilowatt goes. The dashboard shows current consumption, battery status, grid import and savings, so you immediately see how much you save on grid fees.
maxbelasting.ctah: Ready to free your hotel from grid congestion?
maxbelasting.ctap: Calculate within 1 minute what your hotel can save with its own energy system.
